column1: A cube moves at a constant speed in a magnetic field. A disk with coils rotates in a magnetic field. A small ball rolls down a slope and passes through a coil. A straight wire moves vertically up and down in a magnetic field. A ring passes between two fixed magnets. A point charge moves in a circular motion inside a ring coil. A small ball moves in a straight line at a constant speed on a horizontal plane, passing through a coil. A cuboid rotates around its central axis in a magnetic field. A conductor rod slides on a U-shaped rail and passes through a magnetic field. A ring passes by a long straight wire. A rotating magnet approaches a fixed coil. A small ball rolls on an inclined circular track. A cuboid slides at a constant speed on a conductive track. A wire vibrates in a sinusoidal pattern in a magnetic field. A small ball vibrates up and down in a magnetic field generated by a magnet.
